title: Reflective projective billiards in the plane: odd periods, period five, and metric rigidity
summary: We study polygonal projective billiards whose reflection law is constant on each side. We give a single explicit family with an open set of periodic trajectories for every period at least three, including every odd period, and identify the previously known centrally projective examples as a special parameter value. For period five we describe the full scalar-monodromy variety, prove its irreducibility, and show that every configuration preserves a nonzero quadratic form.
